source.title: Ertheia announcement and patchnotes
source.publisher: Inn.games, European Lineage II publisher forum
source.scope: Ertheia class skill table and named abilities; table states effects at maximum learned level.

officialFacts: The named Ertheia skills below are listed under their source class in the European patch notes.
The source skill table presents effects at maximum learned level; it does not establish Aden Arena's local level-by-level unlock schedule.
Source combat values and party/retail mechanics are not copied directly into Aden Arena's single-target card combat.
localDecisions: Aden Arena keeps promotion thresholds 20, 40 and 76.
Aden Arena distributes skills evenly through each class stage, preserving source row order; this is local balance, not official learning-level data.
Aden Arena caps five learned skills per stage for classes outside this Ertheia roster.
Numeric effects, durations, cooldowns, resource costs and unsupported solo-combat translations in european-roster.js are local adaptations and must not be attributed to Lineage II.
